newsitem.title: USA: Lone Star seeks $24.2 mln annual rate hike.
newsitem.headline: Lone Star seeks $24.2 mln annual rate hike.

text.p: Lone Star Pipeline Co said Friday in its seeking a $24.2 million increase in annual rates.
The ENSERCH Corp subsidiary said it asked the Texas Railroad Commission to increase the rate it charges to transport natural gas to the 550 Texas cities it serves.

Noting this was its first base rate increase request in 14 years, the pipeline said its combined rate for purchasing, storing and transporting natural gas would increase about $0.18 per thousand cubic feet or about $0.90 per month for the typical residential customer.
This would be a rise of about 3 percent for that customer.
The company said it proposed the increase be effective November 29.
